Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this RFP — Atlas Health is compiling vendor evidence to close our procurement packet. We have a focused set of questions around cross-border exports, the DPA annex (processor clauses), and evidence for the Data Protection Framework (DPF) mapping.

Attached is the spreadsheet with our baseline questions (tab: "DPF + DPA"), plus a short list of items we need by EOD next Thursday if possible:
- High-level data flow diagram showing where customer data may move between regions
- DPF control references mapped to Redwood controls (column C)
- Copy of the standard DPA annex track changes or redlines
- Evidence for logging/audit (retention, access logs, SIEM)

Can you confirm ownership and a turnaround? Also please indicate if any items require an NDA or a security-specific presigned link for attachments.

Best,
Priya Suresh
Senior Procurement Manager
Atlas Health Solutions

Hi Priya — appreciated the sync earlier this week. Attached is our initial response package and short answers to the spreadsheet. Highlights below and attachments are in the secure Drive folder linked at the bottom.

Highlights / answers to key items:
- Data flows: logical diagram attached (Redwood_dataflow_logical.pdf). Customer data is processed in one of our regional clusters; backups may be replicated to the customer-designated region only. Cross-border transfers to the US occur when customers choose Redwood-hosted model variants; we provide options to pin models to region for EU-only processing.
- DPF mapping: attached CSV maps Atlas control IDs to Redwood controls and evidence links. We included control maturity notes where relevant.
- Logging & retention: audit logs (API request/response headers, auth events) are retained for 365 days in our SIEM; access logs for model artifacts are retained for 90 days by default. Where required, we can extend retention under contract.
- DPA annex: attached draft with tracked changes. We generally accept EU SCC-equivalent clauses; our standard exceptions are around liability caps and subprocessor onboarding timelines. Marissa has summarized our typical negotiation points in the draft cover memo.

Attachments (shared): Redwood_DPF_Mapping_Summary.pdf, DPA_Annex_Draft.docx, Redwood_dataflow_logical.pdf

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and if the attached level of evidence satisfies the packet.
- If Atlas requires raw SIEM exports or deeper logs, we will need an executed NDA and a secure transfer window (we can support a managed data review with redaction).
- Happy to schedule a 30-minute follow-up for Q&A; propose Thu 18 Feb 09:00–09:30 PT.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZatlas-dpf-evidence
